salient_findings: Dilated surface veins on the left breast

key_facts: No family history of breast cancer
Left breast contains a well-defined, soft mass
Dilated surface veins on the left breast
Ultrasonography shows a homogeneously hyperechoic mass
Mammography reveals a heterogeneous lucent mass

Mass is encapsulated with multiple thin septa
No thoracic extension or bony erosion

shortlist.label: Breast Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's presentation of a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins and the imaging findings of a homogeneously hyperechoic mass and a heterogeneous lucent mass are consistent with a lipoma.

shortlist.label: Hamartoma of the Breast
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's age and the presence of a well-defined, soft mass with a 5-year history of progressive enlargement are consistent with a hamartoma.

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's age and the presence of a well-defined, soft mass are consistent with a fibroadenoma, although the size of the mass is larger than typical for this condition.

shortlist.label: Phyllodes Tumor
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's presentation of a large, well-defined mass with a 5-year history of progressive enlargement is consistent with a phyllodes tumor, although the lack of skin changes or nipple discharge makes this less likely.

shortlist.label: Pseudoangiomatous Stromal Hyperplasia (PASH)
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's presentation of a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins and the imaging findings of a homogeneously hyperechoic mass and a heterogeneous lucent mass are consistent with PASH.

raw.rationale: The clinical and imaging findings, including a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins and homogeneous T1- and T2-hyperintense signal on MRI, are consistent with a benign lesion, and the characteristics are most compatible with a breast lipoma.

rejected.label: Hamartoma of the Breast
rejected.why: Hamartomas are typically well-circumscribed but can contain both epithelial and stromal elements, which is not clearly indicated by the imaging findings in this case.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Fibroadenomas are common benign breast tumors but are usually smaller and more mobile than the mass described, and they may have a more heterogeneous appearance on imaging.

rejected.label: Phyllodes Tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors can be large and have a varied appearance on imaging, but they often have a more complex internal structure and may exhibit malignant features, which are not evident in this case.

rejected.label: Pseudoangiomatous Stromal Hyperplasia (PASH)
rejected.why: PASH is a rare benign lesion that can mimic other breast lesions, but it typically presents with a more complex and heterogeneous appearance on imaging, which does not match the homogeneous appearance of the mass in this case.
